target_customer: Food, mining and other industrial plants that burn gas for process heat
problem: Industrial process heat is mostly fossil fuel, and heat pumps have not reached the high temperatures factories need.
business_model: Sale of containerized industrial heat pumps, with a planned Heat-as-a-Service offer
product_category: High temperature industrial heat pumps and energy storage

founders.name: Andrei Klochko
education: PhD in plasma physics, Ecole Polytechnique
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started Airthium in 2015 as CEO and CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a Stirling type engine and heat pump at very high temperature and efficiency is research grade hardware work; company claimed 86 percent of Carnot efficiency.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary engine design is hard to replicate if it works, but it was unproven at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acted; the company is still in prototype and pilot stage per its own roadmap.

market_need_then: Industrial heat is a large share of emissions and decarbonization pressure was growing in Europe. No specific dated source opened.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain industrial messaging: Cheaper, Cleaner Heat for Factories

brand_strength.rationale: Niche B2B hardware brand with trade press coverage only.

pivots.from: Stirling engine energy storage and heat pumps for seasonal storage
pivots.to: Containerized industrial heat pumps for process heat
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; the YC page described storage as a later market

outcome_analysis: Airthium is still developing hardware. Its site reports a V3 prototype reaching 145 C at 1 kW in 2023 to 2025 and a roadmap with a 10 kW demonstrator in 2026 to 2027 and commercial launch targeted for 2029. Funding found is a roughly 3 million euro round in early 2024, so progress is slow and capital light for the technical difficulty.
notes: Aggregators list earlier seed or pre-seed rounds and totals from 2.1M to 8.1M USD; none verified, so only the 2024 round is recorded. Round date: one outlet says 26 February 2024, another page says published April 2024. Amount 3.24M USD is the aggregator conversion of 3M euro. Competitors empty: no dated source near 2017 found (Azelio appears only undated). Founding year conflicts (2015 or 2016).
